name: Kol-Hose
title: Father of Shallum, a wall builder in Jerusalem
summary: Kol-Hose is a person mentioned in the book of Nehemiah. He was the father of Shallum, who led half of the district of Jerusalem and helped rebuild the walls around Jerusalem. Kol-Hose is also mentioned as one of those who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.

keyEvents.title: Shallum's rebuilding of the Fountain Gate
keyEvents.description: Kol-Hose's son Shallum, leader over half of Jerusalem's district, rebuilt the Fountain Gate and the wall near the Pool of Shelah by the king's garden.

keyEvents.title: Sealing of the covenant
keyEvents.description: Kol-Hose is mentioned among the leaders of the people who sealed the covenant to follow God's law under Nehemiah's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Settlement in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Descendants of Kol-Hose settled in the areas around Jerusalem after returning from exile, including in Kiryat-Arba and its villages.

keyEvents.title: The wall-building project in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Under Nehemiah's leadership, many families, including the descendants of Kol-Hose, participated in the great project to rebuild Jerusalem's walls after the Babylonian exile.

keyEvents.title: The People's Commitment to God's Law
keyEvents.description: Kol-Hose was among those who committed themselves to walk according to God's law, which was given through Moses, God's servant, and to keep all the Lord's commands and statutes.
